name: pk-sweeper
description: Safe GitHub issue and pull request review workflows using the local pk-sweeper CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Review GitHub issues and PRs safely from any repo.
interface.longDescription: PK Sweeper teaches Codex how to run the local pk-sweeper CLI from a target repository, inspect open issues and pull requests, generate recommendation reports, and use the Linear PR reviewer path without applying mutating GitHub decisions unless explicitly requested.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use PK Sweeper to review this repository's open GitHub issues and pull requests safely.
